msg.library.off: Look in the community library is off, so Fenrir fetched nothing from it.
msg.library.no_key: This Fenrir has no key for the community library yet, so it uses none of it.
msg.library.address: The library's address is not a secure one, so Fenrir did not fetch from it.
msg.library.unreadable: The library could not be checked, so Fenrir did not use it: its list could not be read.
msg.library.unsigned: The library could not be checked, so Fenrir did not use it: its list was not signed with the library's key.
msg.library.older: The library could not be checked, so Fenrir did not use it: its list is older than one Fenrir has seen already.
msg.library.too_big: The library could not be checked, so Fenrir did not use it: what came is larger than any real file of it.
msg.library.too_slow: The library could not be checked, so Fenrir did not use it: it came in too slowly.
msg.library.needs_newer: The library is for a newer Fenrir, so this one did not use it. Fenrir's next update brings what it needs.
msg.library.unreachable: The community library could not be reached ({why}). Fenrir uses what it fetched before.
msg.library.stale: The library has not been refreshed since {date}.
msg.library.not_listed: The community library does not offer that recipe now.
msg.library.revoked: This recipe was withdrawn from the library: {reason}
msg.library.withdrawn_what: The server keeps running as it is, and nothing was removed. Fenrir offers this recipe for no new server: keep this one, or remove it when you are ready.
msg.library.invalid: The library's {name} did not pass Fenrir's own checks, so Fenrir did not use it. {why}
msg.library.not_its_file: The library's file is not the recipe its list names, so Fenrir did not use it.
msg.library.builtin_id: The library's {id} has the name of one of Fenrir's own recipes, so Fenrir did not use it.
msg.library.fetch_failed: The recipe could not be fetched from the library ({why}).
msg.library.share.not_local: Only a recipe of your own can be shared: save the server as a recipe first.
msg.library.share.invalid: It does not pass the library's checks. {why}
msg.library.share.builtin_id: {id} is the name of one of Fenrir's own recipes: give yours another name before you share it.
msg.library.share.harness: Its test run did not pass: the {step} step said {said}
msg.library.share.path: It holds a path on this PC at {where}: {path}
msg.library.share.pc_name: It holds this PC's name at {where}.
msg.library.share.account: It holds the name of your account on this PC at {where}.
msg.library.share.kept: It holds {what} at {where}: a secret Fenrir keeps.
msg.library.share.format: It holds what looks like {what} at {where}.
msg.library.share.ip: It holds a network address at {where}: {address}
msg.library.share.email: It holds an email address at {where}. Everyone who opens the library can read it.
msg.library.share.random: Something at {where} looks like a key or a token. Check it is not a secret before you share it.
msg.library.share.no_notes: It has no research notes: say where its facts come from, so the reviewer can check them.
msg.library.share.no_live: No run on a real server is recorded. Say so in your notes: the reviewer tries it on a real server where they can.
msg.library.share.ready: It is ready to share. Fenrir opens GitHub with your submission filled in, and you send it from your own account.
msg.library.share.paste: Paste the recipe from your clipboard into the Recipe box.
